item.title: Iowa City Catholic Worker moves Saturday’s Community Defense Training event indoors due to frigid weather forecast
item.description: Lang 1/16/26 The Iowa City Catholic Worker is moving Saturday’s Community Defense Training event indoors due to the frigid weather forecast. The event will now be held from 12-1:30 Saturday afternoon at Dream City on Southgate Avenue.
